brief:
Shehab Wire reported that British Jewish journalist Jonathan Freedland published an article in The Guardian warning that upcoming Israeli elections could be the final elections in the country's history. Freedland, writing under the headline "These elections may be the last in the country's history, and I felt it myself this week," suggested he sensed fundamental shifts during the past week.

The article appears to signal serious concerns about Israel's political trajectory and institutional stability, though Freedland's specific arguments were not detailed in the summary.

title: Jewish writer warns upcoming Israeli elections may be Israel's last
